sources.shortCitation: 4. Verordnung über die Vorführung ausländischer Bildstreifen, 28 June 1933
sources.fullCitation: 4. Verordnung über die Vorführung ausländischer Bildstreifen vom 28. Juni 1933, Art. I, 1, § 2, quoted in Armin Loacker and Martin Prucha, “Österreichisch-deutsche Filmbeziehungen und die unabhängige Spielfilmproduktion 1933–1937,” Modern Austrian Literature 32, no. 4 (1999): 90–91. JSTOR, stable id 24648888.
sources.researchNote: The ordinance is the measure that redefined a “German film” by the citizenship and origin of everyone working on a production, which is what closed the German market to Kaper and Jurmann as Jewish citizens of Poland and Austria. The text reaches this record through Loacker and Prucha rather than from the Reichsgesetzblatt, so the article is what the link resolves to and the reliability is set accordingly. The date is the date of the ordinance itself.
sources.title: Fourth Ordinance on the Exhibition of Foreign Films
